about: The LEGO Spider-Man look applied to the player's LEGO Batman minifig while Spidey is on (prints are original art for this mod, drawn by tools/make_spidey_prints.py onto the minifig layout measured in game with a 16x16 labelled grid). Every change is undone when Spidey goes off. component = minifig part on the player pawn (CharacterMesh0 = body incl. head plastic, Face = animated face decal). component 'attached' + kind hide_others = every visible mesh piece of the minifig except the listed components, so any Batman suit's own cowl, cape and armour disappear. component 'attached' + kind hide_actors = actors the game attaches to the minifig (Batman's gadget props) whose class name contains a listed part, hidden while Spidey is on. value 'game:<path>' = a texture already in LEGO Batman (its flat normal map). enforce_each_frame re-applies values the game's face animation keeps resetting. batman_value = what F6 puts back when the recorded value already looks like the suit (a suit-up after a level load must never bake Spidey into Batman).
